profile.headline: Software Developer Advisor at Fiserv
profile.summary:
Experienced software developer with customer focus in implementing, maintaining as well as supporting activities associated with software deployment projects. Many years of experience interacting with end customers in gathering requirements and implementing solutions based on the customer needs.
Principal strengths include Core Java, J2EE, Spring framework, DB2, Hibernate, Web Services development like SOAP and RESTful APIs.

positions.title: Software developer advisor I
positions.description:
• Lead team of 5 people mentoring and guiding them through the implementation to be delivered as a Team.
• Designed and Built a solution for Digital Document Advantage project providing capabilities for file management, data computational framework.
• Designed and developed (part of team) a framework for migration of legacy applications to Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) platform. 
• Architected and Designed solution for migrating applications and client data between data centers (Different Geo locations), improving security, efficiency and enabled cost savings.
• Incorporated as part of the Solution Design, the usage of Core Java and spring boot framework with REST API interface to interact with many micro services using Rabit-MQ (messaging queue).
• Used following technologies for the development work that I performed as part of the team to implement the Solutions that I Designed / I was part of architecting.
• Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA , Spring Jdbc template, Hibernate, caching , rest client, webclient.
• Redis-cache to share data across micro service.
• Mongo DB to store high volume data from json objects.
• Full stack development with attention to detail on Application securities.
• Unit Testing: Used Junit, mockito spring unit to build test cases and perform automated tests.

positions.title: Senior Professional Application Engineer & Java Developer
positions.description:
Directly worked with number of clients including Kemper Insurance Company, Safety, State Auto, Farm Bureau Insurance, Hartford, and QBE for customer specific modifications, as well as in base product development.

•	Key member of the technical team that developed insurance processing application designed as a multi-tier architecture implemented using spring framework. Presentation layer is built using .NET, HTML and CSS. Middle layer is developed as XML based communication layer using Core Java, XML and HTML. Backend layer uses J2EE and DB2 for database management. 
•	Subject Matter Expert for the CSC’s Exceed Financial Integrator - Responsible for defect triage, resolution and enhancements.  Responsible for working with multiple Clients on the initial configuration and set up for Financial Integrator. 
•	Team Lead for development and successful operation of batch processing tasks for Financial Integrator jobs using CONTROL-M.
•	Level 3 customer support for Kemper billing application developed in Java/hibernate MS SQL.
•	Implemented java web service using MS SQL hibernate for Disbursement external service
•	Developed Java/DB2 application to gather billing activity from policy changes. 
•	Team Lead for batch processing activity for Billing with Safety Insurance Company account
•	Implemented & transformed applications from COBOL to Java for Premium activity (Cancel Pending & Rescissions) pass to CSC’s Series II system from Exceed billing.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•	Designed, developed and validated a COBOL application for EDI processing for State Auto Billing software.
•	Lead design, development and validation for the “Multi Quote Scheduling” for NetExpress interface for State Auto Billing software.
•	Key responsibilities include:
o	Enhancement to redistribute the Quote Schedule Page
o	Performance enhancements to batch processes that reduces the processing time by about 20%
o	Enhanced “Pending Policy Change” page to handle dynamic policy changes 
o	Enhanced receipt detail page that hides some key information like ENS/ERP reason codes
o	Added capability to allow entering 4 digit batch number 
•	Migrated customer database to CSC’s Exceed system that included client’s information for Hartford Insurance Company.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•	Performance and Scalability for 21st Century Insurance Company using CSC’s COGEN insurance application
•	Added/removed unnecessary objects and classes to reduce the complexity and instantiation of objects resulting in improved performance.
•	Worked on fsconnect2 retrofit.
•	Participated in “bug blitz” to actively reduce overall defects for the client.
•	Production Support for Claims Desktops and 3r Front-End Application for 21st Insurance Company:
o	Resolving problems in Claims Loss-Processing dialog, FNOL dialog, JBOs and user interface using Visual Edge.
o	Resolving problems in 3r Desktop using J-Builder.
o	Perform technical research and analysis for Business Analysts.
o	Setup the Unix Base region for Testing
•	Batch Performance Enhancement for Nationwide Insurance Company:
o	Performed Analysis, design and coding for Data caching in Static COGEN tables, reducing the frequency of calls to the database.
•	Design and Development for 21st Century Insurance:
o	Analyzed, designed and coded for major Claims enhancement project. 
o	Performed functional testing for the project. 
o	Involved in UNIX environment support. 
o	Designed and developed in JAVA for the fsConnect JBO's and user interface.
o	Trained claims team in Madison and Austin on UNIX commands and how to use debugger in UNIKIX.
o	On-site production support for 21st Century Insurance Company 
•	Base COGEN Claims Development: 
o	Developed Automatic and Manual Assignment, and Activity Log for Claims Case Management 
o	Supported 4.1 retrofit and Claims conversion for 4.1 release
•	Keystone Insurance Company: 
o	Developed renewal bill printing module used to send the billing notices to policyholders
